## Problem and result

What concrete behavior changes? What remains unimplemented?

## Contracts and ownership

List affected producers/consumers, schema/event changes and migration impact. Name the relevant reviewer.

## Validation

Include exact checks run and their results. Describe any skipped checks or required services. For transaction changes, include concurrency/idempotency/deadline evidence.

## Rollout

Any migration, config, data or provider setup needed? Explain compatibility/rollback if relevant.
